sk.meta.description: Hands-on lessons for editing textures, working with shaders and testing VRChat avatars in Unity.
sk.title: The skill tree
sk.lead: Choose a chapter or search for the next thing you want to try. Open the same lesson in Unity to track your progress.
sk.how.title: Start it in Unity.
sk.how.1: In Unity, open Tools → Avistry → Skill tree.
sk.how.2: Choose a chapter and a skill. Follow Try it on your own avatar.
sk.how.3: Avistry records supported actions as you work. For a manual lesson, check the result in Unity and choose I've got it.
sk.how.note: Progress is kept on your computer only, with medals for each tier. Reset skill progress clears it.
sk.nojs: Open the skill tree in Unity to browse these lessons offline.
